question: Among all molecules that contain iodine atoms and are non-carcinogenic, what is the average number of distinct elements present in those molecules that also have at least one single bond?

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(element_count) FROM (
  SELECT m.XCL_010, COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_003) AS element_count
  FROM molecule m
  INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
  WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
    AND m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT a2.XCL_002 FROM atom a2 WHERE a2.XCL_003 = 'i')
    AND m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT b.XCL_005 FROM bond b WHERE b.XCL_006 = '-')
  GROUP BY m.XCL_010
)

SELECT AVG(element_count) FROM (
  SELECT m.XCL_010, COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_003) AS element_count
  FROM molecule m
  INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
  WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
    AND m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT a2.XCL_002 FROM atom a2 WHERE a2.XCL_003 = 'i')
    AND m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT b.XCL_005 FROM bond b WHERE b.XCL_006 = '-')
  GROUP BY m.XCL_010
)

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
SELECT AVG(element_count) FROM (
  SELECT m.XCL_010, COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_003) AS element_count
  FROM molecule m
  INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
  WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
    AND m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT a2.XCL_002 FROM atom a2 WHERE a2.XCL_003 = 'i')
    AND m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT b.XCL_005 FROM bond b WHERE b.XCL_006 = '-')
  GROUP BY m.XCL_010
)

checks: Eligibility: Molecules are filtered by XCL_011 = '-' (non-carcinogenic), existence of an atom with XCL_003 = 'i' (iodine), and existence of a bond with XCL_006 = '-' (single bond).

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(DISTINCT_ELEMENTS) AS average_distinct_elements
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_003) AS DISTINCT_ELEMENTS
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE 
        m.XCL_011 = 'non-carcinogenic'
        AND a.XCL_003 = 'I'
        AND b.XCL_006 = 'single'
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010
) AS subquery
